items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the duet record she and Ray Charles did together.

ctx.x: Love her. She’s a real jazz singer. No doubt about that. The record that she did, The Genius – they call it The Genius, Ray Charles. I remember. I think it’s called Never Say Goodbye or something like that? Anyway, I remember many wintry nights in New York City I would listen to that record, the duet record she and Ray Charles did together.
I always remember Baby, It’s Cold Outside.
